rows.details: Chargeman (General Central Service, Group B, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial)
Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Electronics Engineering or Production Engineering

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must send their application form filled either in English or Hindi as per the prescribed format given at Annexure-1 with a duly affixed self-attested colour photograph. The application must be accompanied by photocopies of the required documents, self-attested with name and date. No original certificates are to be forwarded along with the application form. Applicants are to enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp (pasted on the envelope) addressed to themselves with the application. The envelope containing the application should be clearly super-scribed in BOLD letters with notation "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHARGEMAN" and also the category under which they applied. The fully filled application with all the necessary attachments must be sent by ordinary post only to the following address: The Director General, (For PD (Rectt))Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment,C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, U.P. - 201309

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: A Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Electronics Engineering or Production Engineering from a recognized University/ Institution. Two years experience in the field of hull repair or general engineering and/or in electrical or electronics trades. Age Limit: Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 30 years. Age Relaxation: Relaxable by 05 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies and 10 years for PwBD candidates (15 years for SC PwBD candidate). content_sections.text: Aadhaar card Matriculation or equivalent marksheet and certificate UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate Latest Category Certificate for reserved category candidates Experience Certificate PwBD Certificate (if applicable) NOC from the employer for candidates presently serving in any government organization (if applicable) Two latest passport size colour photographs A separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp addressed to themselves

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Scrutiny of applications, Document Verification, and Written Examination. Written Examination: All shortlisted candidates will undergo a written examination on the basis of educational qualification prescribed for the post. The written examination will be pen-paper based and bilingual, consisting of 80 objective type questions with one mark for each correct answer and no negative marking. The subjects are Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), Science (20 questions, 20 marks), General Awareness (15 questions, 15 marks), English (15 questions, 15 marks), and Mental Ability/Reasoning (10 questions, 10 marks), with a duration of 01 Hour.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Indian Coast Guard has announced 3 Chargeman vacancies under the Group B Civilian Personnel Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026 is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Marine, Electronics or Production Engineering from a recognized university or institution. Two years of relevant experience in hull repair, general engineering, electrical or electronics trades is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable to eligible candidates as per the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive salary under Level 6 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the prescribed application form in English or Hindi, attach the required self-attested documents and send the complete application by ordinary post to the designated Coast Guard recruitment address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application address for Indian Coast Guard Chargeman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Director General (For PD (Rectt)), Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201309.
